batch_check.result: Checked 15 items, 30 questions; no failures or warnings. Info line: 12 ids already in the catalogue (rewrites).

checks.three_item_set_distributions: Each of the five proposed sets (file order in groups of three) has two keys per letter, unchanged by the repairs.
checks.names: All names come from the 075 pool (Anna, Tom, Ali, Yara, Eva, Kofi, Mei, Jan, Lisa, Samir); Tom and Kofi appear twice each, in different sets; no voice or older-cast names.
checks.meaning_question_limit: 'Wat moet u meenemen?' appears twice (lesboek, nieuw-paspoort).
checks.web_check: No organisation, shop or brand is named; none needed checking.

diversity_and_assembly.evidence: Fifteen different purposes: class reminder, station pickup, coffee invitation, call request, birthday dinner, hen in the garden, class card, coat pickup, moving help, cup purchase, doctor's appointment, dog walk, park lesson, passport pickup, shift dress code. Time-place questions dominate (see limitations); hours are varied (tien tested twice, drie/negen/elf/twee/vier/zes elsewhere). Sets proposed by the author are accepted; Tom and Kofi never share a set.

media_notes.approval: Sources and briefs only; no generated image approved.
media_notes.regenerate: eend-tas brief and alt changed (front door, no bag). Every other brief is unchanged. Rewrites change the text, so all existing pictures and any media for these ids must be regenerated or re-verified against the final brief.
media_notes.risks: Kofi in hond-feest keeps traits man about 30, short black hair, round glasses, green jacket. Check the rendered hen (kip-tuin) shows no tomatoes, the coat (koffer-les) and coat shop (winkel-sok) are clearly different scenes, and the waiting area (nieuw-paspoort) shows no passport.

limitations: Independent AI editorial judgment; no teacher review, learner pilot, validated CEFR difficulty or exam-equivalence claim.
16 of 30 questions ask time or place, and many time options are neighbouring hours; acceptable under the A1 explicit-fact format but monotonous.
kip-tuin asks what the hen eats and until when the neighbour is home instead of the animal and the place requested in the plan; this avoids the picture answering the question.
Combined program tone count is the coordinator's job.
